topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon an online archive one quiet evening, and there it was—my college application essay, a fragment of my past, now a public specimen. The words, once intimately mine, now belonged to the vast, impersonal web, serving as an exemplary guide. The thought of my thoughts, once carefully guarded, now aiding strangers in their quests, felt like a peculiar kind of exposure. I lingered on the page, tracing the sentences, each one a reminder of the effort, the hopes, the nights spent in silent contemplation. It’s strange, seeing a part of yourself dissected and analyzed, a personal journey turned into a template. The room grew colder, and the light outside dimmed, as I realized how small these digital footprints can make one feel.
